_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro: ທ່ານກໍາລັງຫຼີ້ນ Klondike Solitaire. ເປົ້າຫມາຍຂອງທ່ານແມ່ນເພື່ອຍ້າຍບັດທັງຫມົດໄປຫາ stacks ພື້ນຖານ. ກົດລະບຽບເກມ: - stacks ພື້ນຖານ (F1-F4): ສ້າງຈາກ Ace ກັບ King ໃນຊຸດ - Stacks Tableau (T1-T7): ສ້າງລົງສີປ່ຽນກັນ (ສີແດງໃນສີດໍາ, ສີດໍາໃນສີແດງ) - Stock: ດຶງບັດເພື່ອຂີ້ເຫຍື້ອ stack - Waste (W): top ບັດທີ່ມີຢູ່ສໍາລັບການຫຼິ້ນຄໍາສັ່ງ: - 'ດຶງ' - ດຶງບັດຈາກຫຼັກຊັບເພື່ອຂີ້ເຫຍື້ອ - 'ຍ້າຍ <ແຫຼ່ງ> <ຈຸດຫມາຍປາຍທາງ> [count]' - ຍ້າຍບັດລະຫວ່າງ stacks ຕົວຢ່າງ: 'ຍ້າຍ W T1', 'ຍ້າຍ T1 F2 ', 'ຍ້າຍ T3 T5 2'. ສາມາດນັບໄດ້ 'ທັງຫມົດ', ເຊິ່ງຈະພະຍາຍາມທີ່ຈະຍ້າຍບັດທັງຫມົດຫນ້າຂຶ້ນທັນທີ. - 'ສໍາລັບມັນ' - ສິ້ນສຸດເກມແລະລັອກໃນຊື່ຂອງທ່ານໃນປັດຈຸບັນຄະແນນ - Pile: W (ຂີ້ເຫຍື້ອ), F1-F4 (ພົບເຫັນ), T1-T7 (ຂີ້ເຫຍື້ອ) ການປະຕິບັດການປະຕິບັດຫຼາຍສີ (ຂີ້ເຫຍື້ອ) - Waste (W): Top ບັດທີ່ມີຢູ່ສໍາລັບການຫຼິ້ນຄໍາສັ່ງ: 'ດຶງ' - 'ດຶງ' - Draw' - Draw' - Draw ' - Draw' - Draw ' Draw' - Draw ' Draw ' Draw ' - Draw ' Draw ' - Draw ' - Draw ' - ' - ' Draw ' - ' - ' Draw ' - ' - ' - ' Use ' All ' T1 F2', which will try to count also be impossible, which will try to move all cards immediately move all face-up cards in order.
